title: All 7 MCP tools declare an empty inputSchema (no properties/required)
evidence: src/soccer_mcp.erl:10-17 — every tool is registered as inputSchema=>#{type=>"object"} with no properties/required. A strict MCP client reading tools/list cannot discover that standings accepts season/competition or search_matches accepts team/season, so it cannot derive call arguments — this is why the factual probe (_factual.json: 'no tool returned a 2019 Série A table naming Flamengo') and runtime factual_accuracy=0.0 failed. NOTE: this is a self-description/conformance defect only — the argument handling itself IS implemented (see suggestion), so no R1-R12 capability is missing.
suggestion: Populate each tool's inputSchema.properties (e.g. standings: season:int, competition:string; search_matches: team/opponent/competition/season/date_from/date_to) to match the args already parsed in filters/2 (soccer_mcp.erl:43-44) and routed in tool_call/2 (soccer_mcp.erl:28-42).
